advisor_explanations.rationale: Selected LoRA recipe 'r32-a64-lr1e-04-7m' via successive halving across 2 sm_121 nodes: full attention + MoE projection coverage achieved the lowest held-out loss (1.3963, perplexity 4.04) while pruning high-LR/narrow-module trials early.

Selected training config 'sm121-all-kernels-2node-ddp' at 6955 tok/s (83.8% of measured cluster peak): enabling sm_121 chunked 152k-vocab cross-entropy, grouped MoE GEMM, and fused LoRA freed unified memory for larger micro-batches while matching the reference loss curve within 0.0067.

Selected serving config 'nvfp4-2replicas-tp1' delivering 3460 tok/s (P99 425.3 ms): Blackwell NVFP4 + 2 independent data replicas avoided inter-node TP all-reduce overhead and kept perplexity within +1.56% of BF16 while rejecting over-batched configs that breached quality/latency gates.

turnkey_fuzzfile:
# ==============================================================================
# Crucible Turnkey Autoresearch Workflow (ingest -> train -> eval -> serve)
# ==============================================================================
# Cluster        : ciq-gb10-team20 | definitionId: team20
# Nodes          : CIQ-CHI-SPARK39 (192.168.99.48/7331), CIQ-CHI-SPARK40 (192.168.99.49/7331)
# Node Hardware  : 1x NVIDIA-GB10 (Blackwell, sm_121), 20c (cpu/arm64/sve), 127.9 GiB/node
# Per-Node Alloc : 16 cores, 112GiB RAM, 1x nvidia.com/gpu
# Shared Storage : VAST persistent volume 'crucible-vast' mounted at /vast
# Base Model     : Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (MoE, 151,936 vocab, 57.0 GB BF16)
# Dataset        : lammps-cpp (whole-file sealed held-out split; raw data never left VAST)
#
# Measured Autoresearch Decisions:
#   [Stage A - Winning LoRA Recipe]
#     rank=32, alpha=64, lr=0.00015,
#     modules=['q_proj', 'k_proj', 'v_proj', 'o_proj', 'gate_proj', 'up_proj', 'down_proj'], seq_len=2048
#     Held-out perplexity: 6.848 (base) -> 4.040 (fine-tuned)
#
#   [Stage B - Winning Training Performance Config (sm121-all-kernels-2node-ddp)]
#     nodes=2, micro_batch=6, grad_accum=1,
#     activation_checkpointing=False,
#     sm_121 kernels: chunked_ce=True, grouped_moe=True, fused_lora=True
#     Throughput: 1243.2 -> 6955.3 tok/s (5.59x)
#
#   [Stage C - Winning vLLM Serving Config (nvfp4-2replicas-tp1)]
#     precision=NVFP4, replicas=2, tensor_parallel=1,
#     max_num_seqs=96, low_prec_decode_kernel=True
#     Serving throughput: 401.8 -> 3460.3 tok/s
#
# Launch end-to-end on CIQ Fuzzball (Team 20):
#   fuzzball workflow validate final-crucible-workflow.yaml
#   fuzzball workflow start final-crucible-workflow.yaml -n lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-team20
# ==============================================================================

version: v4
annotations:
  fuzzball.io/provisioner_definition_id: team20
volumes:
  vast-shared:
    use: vast
    name: crucible-vast
jobs:
  ingest-lammps:
    image:
      uri: docker://nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.03-py3
    mounts:
      /vast: vast-shared
    env:
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    resource:
      cpu:
        cores: 8
        affinity: NUMA
      memory:
        size: 32GiB
      devices:
        cpu/arm64/sve: 1
    policy:
      timeout:
        execute: 30m
    command:
    - crucible
    - ingest
    - --source-dir
    - /vast/data/lammps
    - --output-dir
    - /vast/data/lammps-packed
    - --seq-len
    - '2048'
  train-lora:
    image:
      uri: docker://nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.03-py3
    mounts:
      /vast: vast-shared
    depends-on:
    - name: ingest-lammps
      status: FINISHED
    env:
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    - NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0
    - CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1
    - TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0;12.1
    resource:
      cpu:
        cores: 16
        affinity: NUMA
      memory:
        size: 112GiB
      devices:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
        cpu/arm64/sve: 1
    policy:
      timeout:
        execute: 4h
    script: "#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail\nmkdir -p /vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/rdzv\n\
      NODE_RANK=\"${OMPI_COMM_WORLD_RANK:-${PMI_RANK:-0}}\"\nif [ \"$NODE_RANK\" =\
      \ \"0\" ]; then hostname -i | awk '{print $1}' > /vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/rdzv/master_ip;\
      \ fi\nwhile [ ! -s /vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/rdzv/master_ip\
      \ ]; do sleep 1; done\nMASTER_ADDR=$(cat /vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/rdzv/master_ip)\n\
      torchrun \\\n  --nnodes=2 \\\n  --nproc_per_node=1 \\\n  --node_rank=\"$NODE_RANK\"\
      \ \\\n  --rdzv_id=\"crucible-prod-train\" \\\n  --rdzv_backend=c10d \\\n  --rdzv_endpoint=\"\
      ${MASTER_ADDR}:29500\" \\\n  -m crucible.trainer.lora_trainer \\\n  --trial-id\
      \ production-lora \\\n  --base-model-dir /vast/models/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B \\\
      \n  --processed-data-dir /vast/data/lammps-packed \\\n  --output-dir /vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production\
      \ \\\n  --max-steps 480 \\\n  --recipe-json '{\"lora_alpha\": 64, \"lora_rank\"\
      : 32, \"lr\": 0.00015, \"seq_len\": 2048, \"target_modules\": [\"q_proj\", \"\
      k_proj\", \"v_proj\", \"o_proj\", \"gate_proj\", \"up_proj\", \"down_proj\"\
      ], \"warmup_ratio\": 0.05}' \\\n  --perf-json '{\"activation_checkpointing\"\
      : false, \"grad_accum_steps\": 1, \"label\": \"sm121-all-kernels-2node-ddp\"\
      , \"micro_batch_size\": 6, \"nodes\": 2, \"use_chunked_ce_kernel\": true, \"\
      use_fused_lora_kernel\": true, \"use_grouped_moe_kernel\": true}'\n"
    multinode:
      nodes: 2
      implementation: generic
      procs-per-node: 1
  eval-held-out:
    image:
      uri: docker://nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.03-py3
    mounts:
      /vast: vast-shared
    depends-on:
    - name: train-lora
      status: FINISHED
    env:
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    resource:
      cpu:
        cores: 16
        affinity: NUMA
      memory:
        size: 112GiB
      devices:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
        cpu/arm64/sve: 1
    policy:
      timeout:
        execute: 45m
    script: "#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail\npython3 - <<'PY'\nimport json, pathlib,\
      \ sys\nsummary = json.loads(pathlib.Path('/vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/summary.json').read_text())\n\
      ceiling = 4.1412\nppl = float(summary['held_out_perplexity'])\nprint(f'Verified\
      \ held-out perplexity: {ppl:.4f} (ceiling: {ceiling:.4f})')\nif ppl > ceiling:\n\
      \    sys.exit('Held-out quality floor check failed \u2014 aborting promotion\
      \ to serving.')\nPY\n"
services:
  serve-vllm:
    image:
      uri: docker://nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.04-py3
    mounts:
      /vast: vast-shared
    depends-on:
    - name: eval-held-out
      status: FINISHED
    env:
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    - FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1
    - CRUCIBLE_USE_LOW_PREC_DECODE=1
    - CRUCIBLE_TARGET_REPLICAS=2
    command:
    - python3
    - -m
    - vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server
    - --model
    - /vast/models/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B
    - --enable-lora
    - --lora-modules
    - crucible-tuned=/vast/runs/lammps-qwen3-coder-30b-production/lora_adapter
    - --tensor-parallel-size
    - '1'
    - --max-num-seqs
    - '96'
    - --attention-backend
    - TRITON_ATTN
    - --port
    - '8000'
    - --quantization
    - modelopt
    - --kv-cache-dtype
    - fp8
    resource:
      cpu:
        cores: 16
        affinity: NUMA
      memory:
        size: 112GiB
      devices:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
        cpu/arm64/sve: 1
    persist: true
    network:
      ports:
      - name: http
        port: 8000
      endpoints:
      - name: crucible-coder-api
        port-name: http
        protocol: http
        type: subdomain
        scope: group
